observations: Photos show a Yamaha electronic keyboard with full-size keys.
Photo 1 clearly shows the brand text “YAMAHA” on the front panel.
Photo 0 shows the control area and a display/LED section, but the exact model number is not readable.
Photo 2 is a close-up of the keys/control area; no model label is readable.

claims.evidence: No model number or specs are readable in the photos to confirm it is a “professional” class keyboard.

risks.risk: Exact Yamaha model is unknown, so the price could be far off (different models have very different values).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model name/number label (usually on the back panel or underside) and the full front panel.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as a generic Yamaha used keyboard of unknown model (worst-case value for an older/entry model), not as a high-end professional unit.

risks.risk: Functionality is not proven (keys, sound, speakers, buttons, display, power).
risks.proof: A short video showing power-on, playing several notes, changing a sound/voice, and volume working (or a test with headphones).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not fully tested / potentially not working, until a working demo is provided.

risks.risk: Physical condition issues (scratches, broken knobs/buttons, missing keys, speaker damage) are not fully assessable from these angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of every knob/button area and both ends of the keyboard, plus a photo of the keybed for any missing/uneven keys.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as having normal wear at best; if any damage is found, treat it as lower condition.

risks.risk: Accessories/stand/power adapter are not shown; missing items reduce value.
risks.proof: Photo of what’s included: power adapter/charger, any stand, sustain pedal, and manuals (if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price it assuming only the keyboard is included (no stand/pedal/adapter unless shown).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the Yamaha model number/label (back or underside).
Video: power-on + playing notes + changing sounds + volume control (and headphone test if possible).
Photos of all controls/knobs/buttons and a full view of the keybed for any defects.
response.reason: The brand is readable (Yamaha), but the exact model and working condition are not verifiable from the photos, so a reliable worst-case price cannot be set without the model label and a basic functionality demo.
